The 1975 version of "Caddie" by Playmatic is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine that retains the golf theme of its predecessor.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
